purpose: Maven $100K — the core-4 book, with gold routed to the SWAP-FREE instrument. Two changes from the single-XAU fallback: (1) 4 sleeves instead of 1, and (2) gold traded as GoldEternal (swap_mode=DISABLED, zero overnight financing) instead of XAUUSD (-3.70%/yr long). The second is the larger effect and is a contractual cost saving, not a signal claim.
_vol_note: 7% dial. Maven's ONLY binding rule is the 10% static max loss (its stated 0% daily rule is infeasible for any strategy — V5_FINDINGS — so exits are managed manually). Measured NET OF MEASURED CARRY, +4% target / 10% max loss / no daily limit, 5 seeds x 1500 sims: 5% dial 98.0% pass / 16.7mo median / 2.0% blow-up; 6% 96.2% / 13.6mo / 3.7%; **7% 93.8% / 11.1mo / 6.1%**; 8% 91.5% / 9.2mo / 8.5%; 9% 89.1% / 7.8mo / 10.9%; 11% 84.0% / 5.7mo / 16.0%. 7% is the balance point: a 4% target at a 5% dial takes ~17 months, which is impractical, and every step up buys ~2 months for ~2.5 points of blow-up risk. Lower it to 5-6% to prioritise survival, raise it to 9% to prioritise speed.
_reset_note: Maven's daily window resets 00:00 UTC on the higher of equity/balance at that instant (maventrading.com FAQ, 2026-08-28).
_classes_note: Equal-class-risk BY DEFAULT, tilted by class_weights above. Sleeve correlations all +0.04..+0.14. Net of Maven's measured carry, business-day aligned: GoldEternal +1.065, BTCUSD +0.570, BRENT +0.437, US100 +0.266; equal-weight book +1.096, gold-tilted +1.212, gold alone +1.065.

XAUCHAMP._broker: Maven FULL, contract 100oz, vmin 0.01, spread $0.55 (1.23bp) measured live, swap_mode=DISABLED (NO overnight financing)
XAUCHAMP._why: Same signal, same sizing, zero carry: XAU sleeve net Sharpe +0.886 -> +1.090 and CAGR +11.85% -> +15.04%, for +0.33bp of extra one-way spread. Book pass rate 96.8% -> 98.0% at a 5% dial with blow-up risk 3.0% -> 2.0%.
XAUCHAMP._basis_check: The obvious objection — a perpetual must charge its funding somewhere — was tested: over the 167 calendar days of history the instrument has (launched ~2026-03-13), the log basis GoldEternal/XAUUSD drifts +0.17%/yr (H1, 2,711 bars) and +0.21%/yr (D1, 143 bars) inside a ~1% band, with 0.998 daily-return correlation. No -3.7%/yr embedded drift. Six months cannot rule out a SMALL drift — re-measure monthly with the probe in V5_FINDINGS §3ag.
XAUCHAMP._gates: BEFORE TRADING: (a) confirm with Maven that synthetic/'Eternal' instruments are permitted under the challenge rules — some firms exclude them; (b) verify fill quality with one 0.01-lot live order, since a synthetic's quoted spread can hide slippage; (c) if either fails, fall back to fp_symbol XAUUSD and drop `vol` to 0.06 to hold the same blow-up risk.

BTC._broker: Maven FULL, spread 8.99bp, swap -30.00%/yr on BOTH sides (INT_OPEN). Net sleeve SR +0.486 (gross +0.932) — still the second-best net sleeve despite the worst carry in the book, so it stays. Verify contract_size and min-lot at execute time.

NDX._broker: Maven FULL, spread 0.30bp, -3.96%/yr. Maven names it US100, not NAS100/NDX.

BRENT._broker: Maven FULL, spread 8.49bp, -4.79%/yr long. NOTE: at FTMO this sleeve EARNED +9.6%/yr; at Maven it pays. It survives on net Sharpe +0.528 anyway (the widest-spread sleeve that still clears), but it is no longer the carry winner it was at FTMO.

_supersedes: configs/v5_xau_maven.json (single-XAU, risk_frac 0.5%, discrete engine via scripts/v5_maven_champ.py). Keep that file as the fallback: it needs no multi-symbol sizing and its once-per-day guard protects manual profit-takes. If it is used, still switch its symbol to GoldEternal — the carry saving applies to the single-XAU version identically.
_correction: An earlier revision of this file quoted 99.9% pass / 6.3mo at a 5% dial. Those figures were GROSS of financing. Net of Maven's measured carry the same book at the same dial is 98.0% / 16.7mo. The gross numbers were wrong to quote; the table in _vol_note is the correct one. ALSO (2026-09-04): sleeve and book Sharpes quoted in the 2026-09-03 revision (+0.951 book, +1.090 gold) were computed on unaligned day counts — BTCUSD quotes weekends, so the book ran on ~365 days/yr and gold on ~259 while both were annualised with sqrt(252). Business-day aligned the correct figures are +1.096 equal-weight and +1.065 gold alone, and the diversified book BEATS gold alone rather than losing to it.
_weights_note: Gold 50% / others 16.7% each, same tilt as configs/v5_gold_max_sharpe.json and for the same reason: gold's net-Sharpe edge is contractual (zero carry) not estimated. Net Sharpe +1.212 vs +1.096 equal weight, on a plateau (40%->+1.200, 60%->+1.196). Needs the class_weights support added to v5_basket_challenge.py 2026-09-04.
